sentences.en: Our city has one third as many people as Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 我们的城市人口是东京的三分之一。

sentences.en: I intend to take my position as a third party.
sentences.zh: 我打算以第三方的身份占据这个位置。

sentences.en: One third of the population of that country cannot read.
sentences.zh: 那个国家有三分之一的人口无法阅读。

senses.zh: 第三；三分之一；（机动车变速器的）第三档
